info.name: New Signature
info.description: Signature piece combining a generative NewSig tiled background, @OneHung SDF text with a Stargate kawoosh water raymarcher. The 25-second looping timeline opens with a giant spiral-in of blocky '@OneHung' lettering over a colorful procedural cell-grid, then at 11.5s a gyroid-FBM portal explodes outward with a twisted-space capsule kawoosh. Audio drives the outer frequency-monitor ring radius and pulses the text glow. Fire rendering illuminates hot cells and text outlines with orange flame.
